title: A curve with only smooth points and nodes over an algebraically closed field is reduced
statement: Let $F$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-field, def-weil-algebraic-closure] and let $C$ be a scheme locally of finite type over $F$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Suppose that every closed point $x$ of $C$ [def-weil-closed-points] at which $C\to\operatorname{Spec}F$ is not smooth (has no open neighbourhood smooth over $F$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]) has $\mathfrak m_x$-adic completed local ring $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{C,x}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] isomorphic as a ring to $F[[u,v]]/(uv)$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Then $C$ is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. No dimension, quasi-compactness, separatedness or properness hypothesis is imposed, and $C$ may be empty.
